name: Xanthic-Gyre
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs towering mountain ranges, stark under a black sky.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Mining charters include clauses about 'subsurface events' that lawyers refuse to define.
